'''Head of Security''' was a position held by many individuals of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Many [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] and [[Senator/Legends|senators]] hired heads of security to foil any attacks or [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempts.

[[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] served as Head of Security of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]].<ref name="FF12" />
